newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 16 bln lire of Italy CCTs.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 16 bln lire of Italy CCTs.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for and were allocated 16 billion lire of seven-year variable-rate certificates (CCT) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 350 billion lire of paper.
Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 8.966 trillion lire at the open auction for the September 1, 2003 paper, against 3.5 trillion lire worth of certificates on offer.
The auction price was set at 101.85 from 101.65 at the previous CCT sale on October 15.
